cases.id: hidden:open freezes a deduplicated eligible set
hidden:choices obey revisions and the deadline boundary
hidden:published generator decides tiers and tie re-rolls
hidden:resolution is idempotent and failed delivery re-awards once
hidden:fairness ledger demotes need at the published boundary
hidden:snapshot hides choices and save load preserves state
server:loot roll component is attached on the master simulation
server:predicted winner receives one real item exactly once
server:failed delivery moves the item to the next-best roll
server:open rolls survive save and load and removal cleans up

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables file list: "scripts/components/lootrollarbiter.lua"
clauses.note: four required files; the evaluator's required-files check plus the attach case

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables: "The pure module `scripts/lootroll/arbiter.lua` returns a table and exports"
clauses.note: every hidden case loads the module and calls the exported names; Arbiter.load is called in case 6

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables: "The pure module must not use any DST global object, `require`, `os` or `io`"
clauses.note: the sandbox has none of these globals, so any use fails every hidden case

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables: "The code must be valid Lua 5.1 and valid Lua 5.4 at the same time"
clauses.note: hidden suite runs on the sandbox Lua (5.4+), the server cases run the same core on the game's Lua 5.1 and compare drawn numbers

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables options table: "`max_rounds` | Maximum number of roll rounds in one contest (including the first round) | `3`"
clauses.note: defaults asserted: max_rounds=3 (g5), max_wins_per_window=2 (w5/w6); window/allowed_items/fairness_window are passed explicitly; default window=30, fairness_window=600 and allowed_items={} are not asserted in the core (weak part)

clauses.anchor: Return values and data shapes item 1: "Every method returns a **new table**"
clauses.note: mutating open().eligible, a resolve result and a snapshot must not leak

clauses.anchor: Return values and data shapes item 2: "and **produces no side effect at all**"
clauses.note: rejected open does not burn the id, rejected choose does not record revision 9, rejected mark_delivered leaves delivered state

clauses.anchor: Return values and data shapes item 3: "Every method that takes `now` checks `now` first"
clauses.note: every method is sampled once or more: open (inf, NaN), choose, resolve, tick, mark_delivered (NaN), cancel (inf), snapshot (NaN), save (-inf)

clauses.anchor: Return values and data shapes item 4: "return the first matching `code` in the order listed for that method"
clauses.note: sampled with multi-fault calls: open (duplicate_roll before item/eligible/seed faults) and choose (unknown_roll, not_eligible, invalid_choice before later faults); the remaining pairs use single-fault inputs

clauses.anchor: Return values and data shapes item 6: "The internal layout of the table returned by `save` is free"
clauses.note: the suite never inspects the layout, it only validates plain data and loads a deep copy

clauses.anchor: Return values and data shapes item 5: "always means Lua string `<` comparison"
clauses.note: eligible order, draw order, snapshot order with ASCII ids

clauses.anchor: Return values and data shapes result table: "(a winner has been selected and delivery confirmation is pending)"
clauses.note: every result field is read: ok, roll_id, item, status, winner, tier, rolls{tier,round,player_id,roll}, demoted, failed, choices{player_id,choice}

clauses.anchor: Return values and data shapes result table choices: "a demoted player still shows"
clauses.note: choices list in case 2; demoted player's original choice in w2

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 1 open validation: "`invalid_time` (`now` or `now + window` is not a finite number)"
clauses.note: invalid_time, invalid_roll_id, duplicate_roll, item_not_allowed, invalid_eligible (3 shapes), invalid_seed (3 shapes)

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 1 open success: "freeze the deduplicated eligible set (copied; the caller's array is not retained)"
clauses.note: deadline = now + window, total, ascending eligible, caller array mutation ignored

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 1 open freeze: "Players who join afterwards cannot take part, and players who leave remain in the set"
clauses.note: outsider gets not_eligible; absent players still count toward completeness and as pass

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 2 choose validation: "`stale_revision` (`revision` is not greater than the **last accepted** revision of that player in that roll)"
clauses.note: unknown_roll, roll_closed, not_eligible, invalid_choice, invalid_revision, stale_revision

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 2 revision: "a rejected call does not record a revision"
clauses.note: revision 9 with an invalid choice, then revision 0 is accepted

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 2 choose success: "complete = (chosen == total)"
clauses.note: chosen/total/complete; a changed choice is not counted twice

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 2 deadline: "or `now >= deadline`); `not_eligible`"
clauses.note: accepted at deadline-0.5, refused at the deadline, also after rebasing

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 2 status: "The passing of the deadline does not change the status by itself"
clauses.note: d4 is canceled 290 s after its deadline; w2/w3 stay open past their deadline until tick

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 3 resolve readiness: "if some player has still not chosen and `now < deadline`, return `not_ready`"
clauses.note: not_ready before the deadline, legal exactly at the deadline, legal early when complete

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 3 resolve idempotence: "directly return the **current** result table of that roll (no more values are drawn; idempotent)"
clauses.note: second resolve compares winner and the whole draw log

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 3 tiers: "if the need tier is non-empty the contest takes place within the need tier"
clauses.note: need beats greed (g1), greed-only (g2), never chose = pass (r1), all pass = unclaimed without draws (g7, t1)

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 4 generator: "`state0 = seed % 2147483646 + 1`"
Core semantics item 4 draw order: "in round 1 every player of the tier draws once in ascending id order (a single player also draws once)"
clauses.note: draw order in rolls; single candidate draws once (d2, r1)

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 4 re-roll: "**only the tied leaders** enter the next round in ascending id order, using the continuing generator state"
clauses.note: g4 (adjacent tie), d1 (p1/p3 tie with p2 between), g5 three rounds then fallback, g6 max_rounds = 1

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 4 ranking: "compare the roll value sequences round by round (lexicographic order, the higher roll value first; a player who did not take part in a round ranks below any roll value)"
clauses.note: d1 ranking p3, p1, p2 differs from id order and from last-roll order

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 4 record: "Every draw is appended to `rolls`"
clauses.note: complete draw logs compared entry by entry

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 5 validation: "`not_awarded` (the status is not"
clauses.note: unknown_roll, not_awarded after unclaimed, delivered and canceled

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 5 success: "and one win is recorded for `winner` in the fairness ledger"
clauses.note: delivered is final; the win appears in snapshot.wins only after mark_delivered(true)

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 5 re-award: "the award passes to the next player in the ranking of the current tier (without drawing again)"
clauses.note: no new draws inside a ranked tier; failed order recorded; server case walks b -> c -> a

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 5 greed tier: "run one new contest for the greed tier with the **continuing generator state**"
clauses.note: d2 and s3 (the latter across save/load)

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 5 termination: "when no candidate is left"
clauses.note: d1 after three failures; server lonely roll

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 5 exactly once: "Each failure call passes the award on by exactly one player, and the same player never becomes the winner twice"
clauses.note: three failures visit three distinct players in ranking order

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 6 formula: "At resolution take `t = math.min(now, deadline)`"
clauses.note: w2/w3 resolved at 200 with deadlines 104/105; w4 resolved early at now

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 6 boundary: "A win exactly `fairness_window` seconds ago no longer counts"
clauses.note: 99 s counts, 100 s does not, for demotion and for snapshot.wins

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 6 threshold: "if the count is `>= max_wins_per_window`, that player is treated as greed in this resolution and is recorded in `demoted`"
clauses.note: limit 1 and default limit 2

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 6 ledger source: "Only `mark_delivered(..., true, ...)` produces a ledger record"
clauses.note: award alone and failed delivery add nothing

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 6 pruning: "An implementation may prune expired ledger records, but must not change any observable result"
clauses.note: snapshot(200) and tick(200) precede the evaluation of w2 at t = 104

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 7 cancel: "after success the status is the final"
clauses.note: cancel result shape, second cancel, cancel after resolution

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 7 final states: "their roll id can never be opened again"
clauses.note: duplicate_roll after resolve, cancel, delivery and load; roll_closed / not_awarded on final rolls

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 7 tick: "and returns `{ ok = true, resolved = <array of result tables in ascending roll id order> }`"
clauses.note: nothing due, three due in id order, not twice; tick result equals resolve result

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 8 snapshot shape: "`rolls` covers every roll that was ever opened successfully, in ascending roll id order"
clauses.note: roll_id, item, status, deadline, remaining, total, chosen, winner, tier for open, awarded and delivered entries

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 8 snapshot privacy: "or any player id in any form (key or value)"
clauses.note: recursive key/value scan of the open entry

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 8 wins: "`count` is the number of wins satisfying `now - win_time < fairness_window`"
clauses.note: w7 makes a smaller id win later, so insertion order and id order differ

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 8 save: "`save(now)` returns a new table containing only strings, numbers, booleans and nested tables without metatables"
clauses.note: suite deep-copies the save with a plain-data validator and loads the copy

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 8 load: "and restores the entire state: eligible sets, choices, revisions, deadlines, generator states"
clauses.note: revisions, deadline, ranking + delivery progress (s2), generator state (s3), final result (s0), ledger, burned ids

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 8 rebase: "then `options.now - <save time>` is added to every stored absolute time"
clauses.note: shift 895 on deadline and ledger; verbatim without options.now; non-table data = new

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 1: "first create `inst._lootroll_state = net_string(inst.GUID,"
clauses.note: server reads TheWorld._lootroll_state:value(); the variable name/dirty event strings and the client branch are regex/unobservable on a dedicated server

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 2: "the whitelist is fixed to these 10 prefabs"
clauses.note: goldnugget accepted, log refused; the other nine prefabs and the fixed window/fairness numbers are not exercised

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 3 Open: "the component generates the roll id (a non-empty string, unique over the whole lifetime of the save, and not to be reused after `OnLoad` either)"
clauses.note: unique ids before and after OnLoad, duplicate entity in the list, refused Open creates no item, Open without a seed succeeds

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 4 Choose: "the component must resolve and deliver **immediately**"
clauses.note: inventory checked before any explicit Resolve; outsider entity gets not_eligible

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 5 Resolve: "calling it again for a roll that has already been resolved returns the same result and must not spawn the item again"
clauses.note: not_ready early, delivered result, second Resolve keeps count and world total

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 6 delivery: "only when a truthy value is returned and, in addition, the item has been merged into a stack the player already had"
clauses.note: stack merge (winner pre-owns a nugget), missing inventory component, maxslots = 0 drop path, AllPlayers lookup allowed in the save/load case

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 6 no leftovers: "One award leaves at most one item, and failed attempts must not leave items behind in the world"
clauses.note: world-wide stack total of goldnugget entities

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 7 timer: "keeps **exactly one** `inst:DoTaskInTime(deadline - GetTime(), ...)` deadline task"
clauses.note: counted through TheWorld.pendingtasks: +1 per open roll, back to the baseline after settlement; that the task really resolves the roll when it fires cannot be observed synchronously

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 7 task hygiene: "the component must not keep any other unfinished `DoTaskInTime`/`DoPeriodicTask` task on the world entity"
clauses.note: exact pendingtasks deltas

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 8 ms_playerleft: "only discard the entity cache of that player, and you **must not** shrink any frozen set"
clauses.note: the event is pushed on a private host entity (never on the live world): the departed player still chooses and rolls, the item goes to the runner-up

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 9 standalone entity: "The component must not assume that `inst` is always `TheWorld`"
clauses.note: both private-host scenarios

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 10 announcement: "announce the result with `TheNet:Announce`"
clauses.note: TheNet is userdata and cannot be observed; regex only

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 10 network state: "in ascending roll id order as `roll_id|item|chosen|total`"
clauses.note: two open rolls joined by ';' in ascending id order, no choice words or userids, settled roll disappears, republished after OnLoad

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 11 OnSave/OnLoad: "`OnLoad(data)` first cancels the old tasks, calls `Arbiter.load` with `options.now = GetTime()`"
clauses.note: plain data, revisions survive, exactly one task per open roll after OnLoad, open roll settles for the predicted winner afterwards, no items created by loading; the clock rebase itself is only covered by the hidden suite

clauses.anchor: Base-game API contract RPC: "The RPC handler receives only the roll id, the choice and the revision"
clauses.note: handler is fetched from MOD_RPC_HANDLERS and invoked with a player entity; that it cannot call Open is a code-review property

clauses.anchor: Base-game API contract methods: "The world component must expose `Open(item_prefab, player_entities, seed)`"
clauses.note: all six methods are checked for existence and four are driven

clauses.anchor: DST integration items 7/8 cleanup: "in `OnRemoveFromEntity` call `RemoveEventCallback` with the same callback"
clauses.note: RemoveComponent on a private host: pendingtasks and the ms_playerleft listener count drop to zero

clauses.anchor: Acceptance closing sentence: "copying individual choices to clients is forbidden"
clauses.note: net state and snapshot scans
